CHECK whether a short, verifiable route exists in the installed Mathlib (e.g., a ready-made Dirichlet/derivative lemma) — no such lemma is available in the files I can inspect without source.
RESULT no short route found; the proof requires several hundred lines of analytic number theory in Lean without source access.
